8×8 Inc (EGHT)’s AI Studio Platform Gets Real-Time Voice Translation

On June 11, 8×8 Inc (NASDAQ:EGHT) added real-time voice translation capability to its AI Studio platform. This feature enables agents and customers to communicate in different languages without an interpreter.
